definitions: A rectangular block of baked clay used for building walls, houses, and other structures.
A toy building block, typically made of plastic, that can be interlocked with others.
A large, rectangular block of something, such as ice cream or cannabis.
A mobile phone, especially an old, large, and unsophisticated one.
examples: The house is made of brick.
He bought a brick of ice cream.
My first mobile phone was a real brick.
